item.title: E-lottery, price cap introduced under new minor mineral leasing rules in Odisha
item.description: The Odisha government has notified new rules for the leasing of minor minerals, replacing the existing auction-based system for sand and stone quarries with an e-lottery mechanism. The policy shift is aimed at curbing cartelisation, enhancing transparency, and strengthening control over mining mafias, while also protecting consumers from inflated mineral prices. item.title: Container truck overturns near Madhupatna fish market in Cuttack, traffic disrupted
item.description: A goods-laden container truck overturned near the Madhupatna fish market in Cuttack on Monday, briefly disrupting traffic movement in the area. According to sources, the container truck was travelling from Khan Nagar towards Madhupatna Chhak when it overturned under circumstances that are yet to be determined. item.title: 57 new Sub-registrar offices to begin operations across Odisha from February 5
item.description: In a move aimed at improving public access to land registration services, the Odisha government has announced that 57 new Sub-Registrar Offices (SROs) will become operational across the state from February 5. The expansion is expected to bring greater convenience for citizens involved in land purchase, sale, and property registration, while also reducing pressure on existing registration offices that often witness heavy footfall. item.title: President Murmu offers prayers at Maa Biraja temple in Jajpur during Odisha visit
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu, who is on a six-day visit to Odisha, visited Jajpur on Tuesday, the second day of her tour, and offered prayers at the revered Maa Biraja Temple, according to her official schedule. item.description: President Droupadi Murmu will perform Pinda Daan, an important ancestral ritual in Hindu tradition, at two sacred sites in Odisha, Nabhi Gaya in Jajpur and Swetaganga in Puri, as part of her ongoing visit to the state. item.title: India-U.S. deal sparks nifty jumps to 4.8%, sensex surges 3,656 points
item.description: The domestic equity markets opened with a historic surge on Tuesday, fueled by upbeat global cues following the announcement of a key India-US trade deal. Benchmark indices witnessed record gains at the opening bell, reflecting strong investor optimism across sectors. The Nifty 50 jumped 1,219.65 points, or 4.86%, to open at 26,308.05, while the BSE Sensex surged 3,656.74 points, or 4.48%, to 85,323.20. item.title: Tiger census begins at Similipal Wildlife Sanctuary using camera traps
item.description: The tiger census has commenced at the Similipal Wildlife Sanctuary, with forest officials deploying camera traps across the reserve to assess the tiger population. As part of the exercise, camera traps are being installed across an area of approximately 2,750 square kilometres. Officials said the cameras are being strategically placed along routes frequently used by tigers to ensure accurate data collection.
